answer: At dawn a claimant stands at a riverbank and records the echo of a sparrow call bouncing off the far bank, with a timestamp and a witness beside the river log. Two river keepers check the recording against the echo registry and the river log within five days. A copied recording, a wrong river, or a missing log entry voids the season, burns a 60-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for a year. One honest listener spends 60 credits; a thousand fakes would need a thousand dawn river walks and a thousand sparrow recordings.
